name: site-agent
description: Inspect and manage WordPress through the existing Site Agent MCP server. Read site context, audit content, create drafts, and apply scoped content or developer changes when authorized.

interface.longDescription: Connect to Site Agent on WordPress to inspect site context, find content and media, audit posts, create drafts, and apply hash-checked edits. Optional source inspection, source editing, PHP and WP-CLI depend on the site's enabled tool groups. Requires a separately authenticated Site Agent connection; credentials are not bundled.
defaultPrompt: Inspect my WordPress site and identify what needs attention.
Audit a post and prepare improvements as a draft.
Inspect a plugin or theme and propose the smallest fix.
